thread:
marta: Heads-up — need to finalize volume thresholds + fallback policy for tiered pricing before Fri. Enterprise customer asked for automatic fallback to Dedicated when burst > threshold, legal needs clear SLAs and contract language. Can we align on numbers + launch gates?

tyler: TL;DR — we need concrete thresholds, what triggers fallback, and what's in-scope for launch (billing, UI, docs, tests).

sam: Proposal: thresholds based on sustained qps and daily tokens. Rough draft:
- soft-tier bump: > 5M tokens/day for 3 consecutive days -> alert + recommend upgrade
- hard-fallback to Dedicated: sustained throughput > 1000 rps for 6 hours OR peak 5k rps for 30m -> auto-route if customer opted-in

jess: Those numbers feel high for SMB customers. Are we gating by customer tier? We should only auto-fallback for customers on enterprise contracts (opt-in) — otherwise just rate-limit + notify.

marta: Agreed. Launch constraint: auto-fallback must be opt-in and documented in contract addendum. For self-serve customers we do recommendation flow only.

liam: Operational checklist for launch:
- billing meter: accurate tokens and route tags (billing-bot test)
- UI: account setting to opt into auto-fallback + clear copy
- rollout: canary to 5 enterprise accounts then open to wider by request
- SLOs: Dedicated SLA attached when fallback occurs (confirm legal wording)

billing-bot: test-metering-run completed on staging. sample output:
```
{ "customer": "acme", "period": "2024-09-01", "tokens": 5234123, "route": "hosted", "fallback": "none" }
```

tyler: Launch gates (must have all):
1) Billing accuracy validated end-to-end (staging + 2 pilot customers)
2) Opt-in UI + API flag + docs
3) Contract addendum drafted + legal sign-off
4) Playbook for ops (how to revert fallback, notification templates)
5) Performance tests showing Dedicated routing meets latency SLOs under fallback load

jess: For prioritization: this is P1 for customers at >= $50k ARR asking for guaranteed throughput. P2 for smaller customers (recommend-only).

marta: Decision items for product meeting tomorrow:
- confirm numeric thresholds (sam proposed)
- sign-off on opt-in requirement (jess + legal)
- triage engineering owners for meter/UI/ops playbook
- schedule pilots (2-3 enterprise customers)

sam: One more: telemetry tags we need for post-launch analysis: route_source, fallback_trigger, pre_fallback_qps, tokens_last_24h. Will add to tracking doc.

marta: Perfect. I'll update the proposal doc and drop links. If anyone has objections to thresholds above, flag here before EOD. :thumbsup:
